offering_description.value: Operates a mobile fintech app offering small cash advances, budgeting tools and a checking account to consumers, mainly those living paycheck to paycheck. Banking services are delivered through a partner bank, and revenue comes from optional fees, tips and interchange.

primary_products.value: short-term cash advances; digital checking account; debit card

primary_services.value: mobile banking app; budgeting and balance monitoring; side-gig job marketplace

customer_segment.value: B2C: underbanked and paycheck-to-paycheck individual consumers in the US

end_markets.value: consumer financial services; consumer lending; digital banking

revenue_model.value: service fees: express transfer fees, optional tips and monthly membership fees on cash advances; transaction or usage fees: debit card interchange fees on checking account spending
revenue_model.category: service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: extends advances funded by its own capital and partner bank accounts, sold directly to consumers via app; software / platform: mobile app platform for banking and budgeting

specialization.value: related lines: cash advances, checking account and budgeting tools aimed at the same consumers

distribution_channels.value: online: mobile app downloaded from app stores and website, with digital marketing

regulatory_exposure.value: high: consumer finance and banking via partner bank, CFPB, state lending rules, FDIC-bank partner oversight, privacy laws
